center.title: Notifications
center.subtitle: Alerts about your connections, bank consents, net worth and plan.

preferences.title: Notification settings
preferences.subtitle: Choose which alerts you get, in the app and by email.
preferences.emailUnavailable: Email alerts are not switched on yet. Your choice is saved and applies once they are.

syncFailed.label: Failed sync
syncFailed.description: A bank, broker or crypto connection could not be updated.

connectionReauth.label: Reconnect needed
connectionReauth.description: A connection needs you to sign in again before it can sync.

consentExpiring.label: Bank consent ending
consentExpiring.description: Your consent for a bank connection ends within two weeks.

netWorthChange.label: Large net worth change
netWorthChange.description: Your net worth moved by 10% or more since the previous day.

billing.label: Plan and payments
billing.description: Your Pro plan started or ended, or a payment failed.

syncFailed.title: {connection} could not be updated
syncFailed.body: The latest sync of {connection} failed. It is retried with the next sync; open the connection if this keeps happening.

connectionReauth.title: Reconnect {connection}
connectionReauth.body: {connection} needs you to sign in again. Until then its balances and holdings are not updated.

consentExpiring.title: Your consent for {connection} ends soon
consentExpiring.body: Your consent for {connection} ends on {at, date, medium}. Renew it to keep the connection syncing.

netWorthUp.title: Your net worth rose by {percent, number, percent}
netWorthUp.body: Your net worth is {percent, number, percent} higher than on {since, date, medium}.

netWorthDown.title: Your net worth fell by {percent, number, percent}
netWorthDown.body: Your net worth is {percent, number, percent} lower than on {since, date, medium}. Check your accounts if this is unexpected.

billingPaymentFailed.title: Your payment failed
billingPaymentFailed.body: We could not charge your payment method for Fiscalis Pro. Update it in Billing to keep Pro.

billingSubscriptionStarted.title: Welcome to Pro
billingSubscriptionStarted.body: Your Fiscalis Pro plan is active. Thank you for your support.

billingSubscriptionEnded.title: Your Pro plan has ended
billingSubscriptionEnded.body: You are on the Free plan now. Your data stays as it is; you can upgrade again in Billing.

email.footer: You get this email because email alerts are on in your Fiscalis notification settings.
